1–2 hours (plus the time to collect Demonic Essences for the ranks)

Beneath the Plains of Havoc lies the path to the {wiki:Dream Realm}. You pass a series of puzzles (colours, levers, tic-tac-toe and the dream room) and choose to join the {wiki:Nightmare Knights|Nightmare Knights} or the {wiki:Brotherhood of Bones}. You earn achievements, teleports from the Knightwatch Tower to several cities, your faction's outfits and, by ranking up with Demonic Essences, a {item:Nightmare Shield} or {item:Necromancer Shield}.
To join the ranks of the Nightmare Knights or the Brotherhood of Bones you have to pass the dream challenge and prove yourself worthy. For that you will also have to kill many demons.

Creating the outfit documents in the Dream Realm
One {item:Small Diamond} per document, at the altars in the officers' quarters.
Bring {item:Orichalcum Pearl|Orichalcum Pearls}: they are needed to use the teleports and let you leave without crossing the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} again.
In the Plains of Havoc you may meet {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Cyclops} and, at times, a {creature:Giant Spider} or a {creature:Dragon} lured by other players.
Several teleports close if someone else enters first: move quickly after solving each puzzle.
Low-level Mages: turn on {spell:Magic Shield|Mana Shield} before pulling the mission 3 levers.

The {wiki:Plains of Havoc} are **southwest** of Venore (and southeast of Kazordoon): leave Venore and walk to the Plains of Havoc temple (where {npc:Oldrak} is). From there walk **east** and enter the ruined building. Use the {item:Shovel} on the hole to the **northeast** and go down.
Walk **east** to the other room. Use the {item:Pick} on the floor until you open a hole and go down.
With the {item:Carrot} in your backpack, walk towards the trees: you are teleported to the other side and the carrot disappears. Free accounts cannot pass here.
Using the Fire Bug after the Poison Fields
Keep going up and turn **left**. There is an area with {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields}; right after it there is an empty space. Use the {item:Fire Bug} on that space: a teleport appears.
Poison Fields area and the space where to use the Fire Bug
Enter the teleport. You are in a room full of trees; above the trees there is a switch on the floor. **Throw** a {item:Death Ring} onto the switch: the trees open and you can enter.
Throw the Death Ring onto the switch above the trees
You have to go in before anyone else, otherwise the passage closes.
This is the start of the Dreamer's Challenge. Use the levers to put the 4 colours in the right places, a bit like a Rubik's cube. Follow the solution in the images.
After solving it, run **south** and enter the **right** teleport before someone else does.
You are in a long, curved corridor and you can see a strange room. Enter the **south** teleport: you arrive in a small room with 4 levers and a teleport.

Get your healing ready (or {spell:Magic Shield|Mana Shield}). Pull the 4 levers in this order: **southeast → southwest → northeast → northwest**. The four walls disappear and the 12 {creature:Ominous Pillar|Ominous Pillars} around you start dealing more and more damage.
Lever order: SE, SW, NE, NW
You can take up to ~700 damage. If you die here you cannot recover your corpse.
As soon as the 4 walls fall, enter the teleport next to you as fast as possible.
If you enter the teleport before all the walls have fallen, you go back to the previous teleport.

Walk **southwest** and pull the lever north of the white pillars. To the south is the NPC {npc:A Ghostly Woman (Dream Realm)}. If you give her {item:Boots} ({key:boots}, {key:yes}) she gives you a hint, but you **don't need** boots to do the quest.
Go **east** and enter the {item:Bed|beds} room. Open the only {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} in the room to receive the {item:Book of the Lost Heroes (Book)|Book of the Lost Heroes}.

Walk **north** to the board: 36 squares, 6 rows and 6 columns. The book has six 6-letter names: each name is a row and each letter a column. Use the lever to make an X or an O appear and place them where the name has an X or an O (the other squares stay empty). Check the orientation against the image.
Run to the ghost NPC's room. Pull the lever: the pillars go back to the north side of the room. Pull it again: a teleport appears. Enter.
Only one person in the group needs to solve the board; the others only have to pull the lever to activate the teleport.
Placing the rings on the squares
There are 4 special squares in this room. Put a {item:Life Ring} on the **north** square and a {item:Death Ring} on the **south** square.
The four squares of the dream room
Go **northwest** and pull the lever: the well fills with {item:Slime (Liquid)|Slime} and the electricity is turned on.
Go back to the four squares. Pour your {item:Water (Liquid)|water} on the **west** square and use a {item:Fire Field Rune|Fire Field} on the **east** square. A teleport appears in the centre.
If you get a PZ lock (from using the rune), wait for it to wear off before you enter.

You arrive in a room with a bed and teleports around it. Enter a teleport: you start to *dreamwalk* through the Dreampaths of the Dream Realm. The monsters are just decoration and can't hurt you. Keep moving and jumping through the teleports to the end.
Bed room with the teleports around it
Without {item:Helmet of the Deep|diving gear} you can drown if you stay still for too long in the underwater part.

You end up in a room with the NPC {npc:A Ghostly Guardian} and get the **Lucid Dreamer** achievement. There are 4 boxes in the room: each has a {item:Bag} with a vial of {item:Wine}, {item:Brown Bread} and a {item:Certificate}.
You can only choose one. The reward changes depending on the faction, but the following missions are the same.

Keep going **north** to the crossroads. Enter the **west** teleport for the {wiki:Brotherhood of Bones} ({npc:The Bone Master}) or the **north** teleport for the {wiki:Nightmare Knights} ({npc:The Dream Master}).

Talk to the leader you chose and say {key:hi} and {key:join}. You get the **Nightmare Knight** or **Bone Brother** achievement, the rank **Novice** (Nightmare Knights) or **Maggot** (Brotherhood) and can use the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower} teleports to **Carlin**, **Thais** and the **Dream Realm**.
From now on you can use a {item:Document of the Follower} to receive your faction's outfit.

To leave, enter the teleport near {npc:A Ghostly Guardian}. With an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} on you and the rank of Novice/Maggot, you can use the teleports on the **2nd floor** of the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower} to **Thais** or **Carlin** and you don't need to cross the Plains of Havoc. Without a pearl, walk back through the Plains of Havoc to Venore, to the **northeast**.

Collect {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences} by killing {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares} in the {wiki:Formorgar Mines} or in the {wiki:Cemetery Quarter} of Yalahar. To use the Knightwatch Tower teleports you always need an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}.

To return to your leader, go to the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}, in the south of the Plains of Havoc: enter through the hole hidden under a tree by the water, a little **north** of the tower. Go up to the **2nd floor** and use the teleport to the **Dream Realm** (you must have an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} on you). To leave, do the same as at the end of the previous mission (Knightwatch Tower teleports).
Hidden hole behind the tree (Knightwatch Tower)

Take 500 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences} to your leader ({npc:The Dream Master} or {npc:The Bone Master}). Say {key:demonic essence} and then {key:advancement}. You rise to **Initiate** (Nightmare Knights) or **Hyaena** (Brotherhood) and can use the teleports to **Ab'Dendriel**, **Fibula** and **Kazordoon**. You can also use a {item:Document of the Officer} for the first addon.

Take another 1000 essences and ask for {key:advancement}. You rise to **Dreamer** and receive a {item:Nightmare Shield} (Nightmare Knights) or to **Death Dealer** and receive a {item:Necromancer Shield} (Brotherhood). You can use a {item:Document of the Leader} for the second addon. After using all three documents you get the **Nightmare Walker** or **Skull and Bones** achievement.

If you handed in all 1500 essences at once at the first promotion, no problem: you can still rank up.

Take another 1500 essences and ask for {key:advancement}. You rise to **Lord Protector** (Nightmare Knights) or **Dread Lord** (Brotherhood) and get the achievement of the same name. You can use the teleports to **Darashia**, **Ankrahmun** and **Mintwallin** and create your own outfit documents.

Go to the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}, in the south of the Plains of Havoc, and enter through the hole hidden behind a tree, by the water. Place the Small Diamond on the altar in front of you

With the rank of Lord Protector/Dread Lord and an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}, you can use all the Knightwatch Tower teleports: 2nd floor to Thais, Carlin and Dream Realm; 3rd floor to Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel and Fibula; 4th floor to Darashia, Ankrahmun and Mintwallin.
To use any Knightwatch Tower teleport you must have an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} on you.
In the summary, the NPC indicated in the rank steps is {npc:The Dream Master}; if you chose the Brotherhood, talk to {npc:The Bone Master}.
